verdict.rationale: Firebase documents several first-party programmatic surfaces that cover many console tasks. The CLI deploys code, interacts with database data, imports and exports Auth users, and issues CI tokens. The official MCP server creates and manages projects, manages Auth users, and works with Firestore and SQL Connect data, and SDKs create and manage users. However, nothing documents that every UI capability is reachable via API, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim or a full management API reference, a published OpenAPI spec, programmatic coverage of console-only features (e.g. Gemini console chat, billing, analytics), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
